overall: The AG declined to review the less-than-quorum meeting complaint, but found the Traffic Commission violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to timely review and respond to the first complaint, and ordered future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that fewer than a quorum of the Traffic Commission met on January 18, and that the gathering was improper.
allegations.key_passage: We do not review this complaint because the allegations of the complaint, even if true, would not constitute a violation of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Commission did not review or respond to the first Open Meeting Law complaint within the required 14 business days.
allegations.key_passage: For the reasons stated above, we find that the Commission violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to timely respond to an Open Meeting Law complaint.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
remedy_passage: We order the Commission’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
